problems.stem: Your nav links render as plain text and the page below them is also blue and underlined. You forgot to close an anchor tag: AboutProjects. What is the actual bug?
options: The first was never closed with , so the link wraps everything until the next close tag
GitHub Pages does not allow links
You used the wrong color in CSS
problems.explanation: A missing leaves the first link open, so following content is swallowed into the anchor. Closing the tag fixes the runaway styling.

problems.stem: Which prompt to an AI debugging assistant is most likely to get a useful, verifiable answer?
options: My website is broken, fix it
My nav links show as plain text. Here is my index.html nav block and my style.css 'nav a' rule. What in this code prevents the styles from applying?
problems.explanation: A good debugging prompt states the symptom, pastes the relevant code, and asks a specific question. That lets you check the answer against your own files.

problems.stem: An AI says your image will not load because of a CORS policy and gives you a long server config. Your image is a local file headshot.jpg in the same folder. What is the most likely real cause, and the right response?
options: Apply the server config; the AI must be right
Distrust the off-target answer: a same-folder local image has no CORS issue, so check the filename, case, and src path first
Remove all images from the site
Move the whole project to a different country
problems.explanation: AI sometimes diagnoses a problem you do not have. A local same-folder image cannot trigger CORS, so the realistic cause is a path or filename typo. Judge the suggestion against your context.

problems.stem: After AI suggests a fix, what single tool best confirms whether the fix actually resolved the error before you commit it?
options: Reading the AI response again more carefully
Opening the browser developer console to see whether the error message is gone after reloading
Asking the AI if it is sure
problems.explanation: The browser console shows real errors. Reloading and confirming the message disappeared is direct evidence the fix worked, independent of the AI's confidence.
